comments.content: As a heads up I try and send pay weekly but in practice it ends up being every couple of weeks on average. Not sure how this will affect ongoing plans but I think more frequent payroll is desired by the team so I aim for it.

If they are in the Ubiquity shared Google Drive folder (they will automatically prefix with `[0094-UBQY]` then they automatically are shared to everybody on the team as a heads up. You may need to either configure the privacy individually on those documents, or less optimally have them outside of the Ubiquity folder. 
Sure I added it to January tab although I will need to manually add those missing gmails when you get them.
My [old payroll system](https://youtu.be/w6KlTRi7nsQ?si=YKEABDItJv60ey4V) requested a blurb on what they got done that week so it could be useful to incorporate that as well for monthly checkins etc

For capital efficiency and security reasons, it's tedious to take a loan from AAVE via a multisig and then disperse it but it's best if I handle it. The people side could be useful to get your help on!
@gentlementlegen  any luck with the pull request settings for non code repositories?
